# Lynx CLI reference

## `lynx`

```text
Lynx project scaffolding, diagnostics, and validation

Usage: lynx [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  new
  doctor
  validate
  build
  run
  test
  content
  migrate      Preview, apply, or roll back a content migration
  completions  Generate shell completion definitions from the CLI command tree
  reference    Write the generated Markdown command reference
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json


  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

## `lynx new`

```text
Usage: new [OPTIONS] <NAME>

Arguments:
  <NAME>


Options:
      --json


      --template <TEMPLATE>
          [default: minimal]
          [possible values: minimal, mmorpg]

      --output <OUTPUT>
          [default: .]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

Both templates include a typed `link.lever_to_door` definition and a starter
zone with an interactable lever connected to a door. The generated
`content/definitions/README.md` describes the endpoint component, event, and
action contract for adding more link definitions.

## `lynx content build`

```text
Usage: build [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json


      --project <PROJECT>
          Project directory containing content/

          [default: .]

      --output <OUTPUT>
          Manifest output path, relative to the project when not absolute

          [default: content/manifest.json]

      --content-version <CONTENT_VERSION>
          Semantic content bundle version recorded in the manifest

          [default: 0.1.0]

      --engine <ENGINE>
          Compatible engine semantic-version requirement

          [default: ^0.1]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `lynx content publish-check`

```text
Usage: publish-check [OPTIONS] --manifest <MANIFEST> --base <BASE>

Options:
      --json


      --manifest <MANIFEST>
          Candidate manifest to publish

      --base <BASE>
          Manifest of the content version clients already have

      --skip-review
          Publish without requiring a moderation approval

      --allow-self-review
          Allow the author to approve their own content

      --license-optional
          Publish without requiring a declared license

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `lynx migrate`

```text
Preview, apply, or roll back a content migration

Usage: migrate [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  apply     Validate and preview a migration; pass --apply to commit it
  rollback  Restore the exact content snapshot retained by a prior apply
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json


  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `lynx migrate apply`

```text
Validate and preview a migration; pass --apply to commit it

Usage: apply [OPTIONS] --plan <PLAN>

Options:
      --json


      --project <PROJECT>
          Project directory containing content/manifest.json and content files

          [default: .]

      --plan <PLAN>
          Reviewed RON migration plan

      --apply
          Commit the validated candidate; without this flag the command is a dry run

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `lynx migrate rollback`

```text
Restore the exact content snapshot retained by a prior apply

Usage: rollback [OPTIONS] --id <ID>

Options:
      --json


      --project <PROJECT>
          Project directory containing content/ and .lynx/migrations/

          [default: .]

      --id <ID>
          Migration ID whose retained source content should be restored

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
